query:
SELECT u.id, u.name, u.email, u.tokenBalance, u.createdAt, u.lastLoginAt,
       COUNT(a.id) as actionCount
FROM app_users u
LEFT JOIN user_actions a ON a.appUserId = u.id
GROUP BY u.id
ORDER BY u.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 2;
